audience: on-call engineers and incident managers who respond to alerts in Zenduty

useCases.title: Find who is on call right now
useCases.text: List the teams to get a team id. Then see who is on call per escalation policy, and read the on-call schedules.

useCases.title: Review open incidents and their alerts
useCases.text: List open incidents, filtered by status or date. Open one incident and read the alerts grouped into it.

useCases.title: Read incident notes and responders
useCases.text: Read the notes added to an incident. Check which responders accepted, declined or have not answered yet.

useCases.title: Acknowledge, resolve or reassign an incident
useCases.text: Read the incident first. Change its status, urgency or assignee. Fields you do not pass stay unchanged.

useCases.title: Create an incident and record notes
useCases.text: Create an incident on a service. This pages the on-call people. Add a note to the incident timeline.
